text_block_list.text:
Well, there you have it! The Arima Kinen
is mine!
And with it, I finish the year in
the starring role!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Your king reigns supreme! Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Yes! Praise me more and more! Raise
your voice
high and laud my grand
achievement!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: After ten minutes of this...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! ♪ Who's the king of Arima

Kineeen? ♪
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
Монолог
choice_data_list: You'll be the star of tonight's concert too!

text_block_list.text: Gasp! Wait, that's right! I have to get ready for the concert!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
For I am Кинг Хало! I took center stage
during the
Arima Kinen, so I'll take
center stage in the
performance!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
With that said, Кинг Хало turns and
cheerfully
skips away.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The racecourse staff sends me their
thanks as I
return to the waiting room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You can come in, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Creak...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm perfect! More perfect than ever!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll be off to wait in the wi—
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Buzz, buzz.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ugh, someone's calling me now? Sigh... Don't they realize what time it is?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hmph, of course it's her. Oh, well, this
should
only take a second.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: BeЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hello, Mother? I'm about to give a
performance,
you know.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I didn't think you'd go so far as to even
win the
Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. What are you so surprised about?
It was a
well-deserved victory.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm Кинг Хало, you know. Your daughter,
the
first-rate Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
And before you know it, everyone will
remember
you as simply "Кинг Хало's
mother."
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you think you can surpass me
now?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text:
That's right. And perhaps someday I'll
even grant
you the honor of wearing
your brand's signature
racewear.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: You really are foolish.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text: Knock, knock!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
King, it's time to go! The performance
starts in
five minutes!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Already?! Are you serious?! Trainer, take
this!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Whap!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Nice catch!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Now, I'm off!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: See you!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
My daughter has been blessed with
great rivals
and a great trainer.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text:
I have to admit, she sounds like she's
enjoying
herself, running out there.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text:
It seems everything I've done until now
was
unnecessary.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text:
I apologize for any inconvenience she
may cause,
but please continue to watch
over her.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text: Click... BeЭпизод..
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Should I say like mother, like daughter?
Or like
daughter, like mother?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's make it a night to
remember! Come
on, everyone!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup. Hope you're ready to pick up
my slack.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's goes without saying! Let's
give it our
all! ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Nnngh! King, you better not disappoint
on center
stage!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! I wonder if I'll be able to keep up
with
everyone!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
So everyone still acts this way even
before going
on stage.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Well, I guess we are who we are.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: All right, it's showtime everyone! Ready?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Everyone

text_block_list.text:
Their separate voices, once at odds with
each
other, now come together in
harmony to ring
throughout the venue.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying, but their winning
concert
will be remembered for a long
time to come.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
